import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    private void run() {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
             PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
            
            String[] tokens = br.readLine().trim().split(" +");
            int n = Integer.parseInt(tokens[0]);
            int m = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
            
            Mod998 mod = new Mod998();
            
            // Calculate expected number of draws to collect all n numbers in one phase
            // E = sum_{k=0}^{n-1} (n+m)/(n-k) = sum_{i=1}^{n} (n+m)/i
            long phaseSize = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                long inv_i = mod.inv(i);
                phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, mod.mult(n + m, inv_i));
            }
            
            // Expected number of phases needed = sum_{k=1}^{n} (-1)^(k+1) * C(n,k) / (1 - C(m, k)/C(m+k, k))
            // Simplify: 1 - C(m,k)/C(m+k,k) = 1 - m!/(k!*(m-k)!) / ((m+k)!/(k!*m!)) = 1 - (m!)^2/( (m-k)! * (m+k)! ) * k!
            // Actually: C(m,k)/C(m+k,k) = (m choose k) / (m+k choose k) = (m!/(k!(m-k)!)) / ((m+k)!/(k!m!)) = (m!)^2 / ((m-k)!*(m+k)!)
            // But simpler: C(m,k)/C(m+k,k) = product_{i=0}^{k-1} (m-i)/(m+k-i) = product_{i=0}^{k-1} (m-i)/(m+k-i)
            // And 1 - this = 1 - product_{i=0}^{k-1} (m-i)/(m+k-i) = 1 - product_{i=0}^{k-1} (m-i)/(m+k-i)
            
            long total = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                long sign = ((k % 2) == 1) ? 1 : mod.modulus() - 1;
                
                // Calculate C(m, k) / C(m+k, k)
                long prNoSpecial = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                    long num = m - i;
                    long den = m + k - i;
                    prNoSpecial = mod.mult(prNoSpecial, mod.mult(num, mod.inv(den)));
                }
                
                long oneMinusPr = mod.subtract(1, prNoSpecial);
                long numPhases = mod.inv(oneMinusPr);
                long e = mod.mult(numPhases, phaseSize);
                
                long comb = mod.ncr(n, k);
                long term = mod.mult(comb, e);
                total = mod.add(total, mod.mult(sign, term));
            }
            
            pw.println(total);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new RuntimeException(e);
        }
    }

    static class Mod998 extends Modulus<Mod998> {
        @Override
        public long modulus() {
            return 998_244_353L;
        }
    }

    static abstract class Modulus<M extends Modulus<M>> {
        private final List<Long> factCache = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<Long> invFactCache = new ArrayList<>();

        public abstract long modulus();

        public Modulus() {
            factCache.add(1L);
            invFactCache.add(1L);
        }

        public long fact(int n) {
            while (factCache.size() <= n) {
                int size = factCache.size();
                factCache.add(mult(factCache.get(size - 1), (long) size));
            }
            return factCache.get(n);
        }

        public long fInv(int n) {
            int last = invFactCache.size() - 1;
            if (last < n) {
                int needed = n - last;
                long[] buffer = new long[needed];
                buffer[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < needed; i++) {
                    buffer[i] = mult(buffer[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = needed - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactCache.add(buffer[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactCache.get(n);
        }

        public long ncr(int n, int r) {
            if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        public long normalize(long x) {
            x %= modulus();
            return x < 0 ? x + modulus() : x;
        }

        public long add(long a, long b) {
            long sum = a + b;
            return sum < modulus() ? sum : sum - modulus();
        }

        public long subtract(long a, long b) {
            long diff = a - b;
            return diff < 0 ? diff + modulus() : diff;
        }

        public long mult(long... values) {
            long res = 1;
            for (long val : values) res = mult(res, val);
            return res;
        }

        public long mult(long a, long b) {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        public long div(long a, long b) {
            return mult(a, inv(b));
        }

        public long inv(long val) {
            long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long r = val; r != 0; ) {
                long q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                long tmp = g;
                g = r;
                r = tmp;
                x -= q * y;
                tmp = x;
                x = y;
                y = tmp;
            }
            return normalize(x);
        }
    }
}
